lines.say: Nobody tells you this, but YouTubers pay for AI thumbnails on Fiverr.
lines.show: Nobody tells you YouTubers pay for AI thumbnails.

lines.say: Here are three sites that pay you for AI work. Number three's my top pick.
lines.show: 3 sites that pay. Number 3 is my favourite.

lines.say: One, Adobe Stock. You sell AI images, as long as you mark them as AI.
lines.show: 1. Adobe Stock: AI images, labelled as AI.

lines.say: Two, Fiverr. You make AI thumbnails for YouTubers.
Three, Eleven Labs. You share your own voice clone and earn when people use it.
lines.show: 3. ElevenLabs Voice Library: your own voice.

lines.say: Nobody else can upload your voice. It's yours.
lines.show: Nobody else can upload your voice.

lines.say: Here's the catch. Adobe rejects a lot. Voice pay depends on use. Fiverr's slow at first.
lines.show: The catch: rejections, slow orders, pay varies.

lines.say: Got a friend with a radio voice? Send them this. Comment SITES for the full list.
lines.show: Send this to your radio-voice friend. Comment SITES.
